fitting.why: D4-W0-F1: the D3 learned store holds no observations and no datasets, so no predecessor row can be inherited

sprint_21c3_corpus.cost: a flat risk-coverage curve between 200 and 320 is weaker evidence for hypothesis_class_bound than a flat curve to 440 would have been; S21D4-039 must report that limitation rather than let a reader infer a stronger conclusion than the spacing supports
sprint_21c3_corpus.reason: excluded by release-owner decision, not by failed audit; it would have carried the pool to about 110 groups and 440 outcomes only if roughly thirty of its groups cleared a rights and disjointness audit that has not been run

definitions.coverage: answered independent decisions over all independent decisions
definitions.independent_ranking_decision: one ranking decision whose fitted feature vector is distinct from every other counted decision in the same set
definitions.replicated_decision: a counted decision whose fitted vector equals another's; valid invariance evidence, never an accuracy, error or coverage denominator

invariants: every reported rate names its denominator
accuracy, error and coverage rates use the independent denominator
decision_independence.refusal: schema validation refuses a decision set reporting an accuracy, error or coverage rate over the nominal denominator
decision_independence.why: S21D4-001 recomputed, over all 24 D3 settings, that ood_answered was six times clean_answered and confident_ood_errors six times clean errors. The metamorphic set was 20 decisions replicated six times.

power_and_yield.coverage_floor_justification: 0.40 over 60 final groups projects 24 answered decisions, which is the smallest coverage that can still satisfy condition 13's floor of 20 changed decisions
power_and_yield.why_0_80_was_wrong: D3's 0.80 floor was a self-imposed rule, not a Gate L2 threshold. Combined with a zero-error requirement certified on 20 decisions it was unsatisfiable by construction: the grid offered coverage 0.95 with six clean errors or 0.50 with two, and nothing between. A selective ranker buys precision with coverage, and a floor forbidding the purchase forbids the mechanism.

bounded_ged_decision.criterion: two identical passes must agree byte for byte on every arm; the arm is retired if a fixed budget cannot reproduce a stable ranking
bounded_ged_decision.d1_d2_d3_numbers: stay marked irreproducible; nothing is back-filled
bounded_ged_decision.option_a: a fixed iteration budget from networkx.optimize_graph_edit_distance, which is host-independent
bounded_ged_decision.option_b: retirement from the frozen set, reported with its reason
bounded_ged_decision.problem: networkx.graph_edit_distance under a wall-clock timeout is an anytime search, so the score depends on the host and the moment

searchable_surface.adds: no new store, no new index, no dependency
derivation: resolve each node's source blob through the released graph store
normalise with correction_source.canonical_source_bytes, the released alpha-normaliser
emit a bounded deterministic term list under the existing 1024-character attribute bound and the existing forbidden-marker guard
searchable_surface.leak_guard: reality_leakage.judgement_leaks must report nothing; a hit refuses the whole projection, fail-closed
searchable_surface.why_excluded: labelled graph-edit distance, edit-path round-tripping and every stored D1, D2 and D3 structural hash must stay byte-unchanged

selective_operating_point.adds: no model, no fit, no dependency, no new fitted channel
selective_operating_point.artifact_binding: the derived threshold and its calibration provenance are part of the selected candidate's identity and are sealed before final access
derivation: compute the score for every independent clean calibration decision
sort answered decisions by score descending
the zero-error point is the highest threshold at which every answered decision above it is correct
report its coverage and the Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% upper bound on the true error rate, which for zero errors in n is 1 - 0.05 ** (1 / n)
selective_operating_point.score: the released bounded k-NN confidence for one ranking decision
selective_operating_point.selection_precedence: a released fixed floor is preferred when it satisfies the non-silence rules; only if none does may the derived point be selected
selective_operating_point.single_shot: exactly one derivation, from the declared calibration split only; a threshold derived from final, promotion or metamorphic data is invalid

calibration_invariance_sample.note: the transformed set is a regression test, never an accuracy sample

submanifests.semantic_mutation_controls: seeded operator and branch-condition mutations remain mandatory and must change the canonical representation

unchanged_from_d3.note: D4 changes no encoder, no normaliser and no fitted representation
